t: This is St Matthew's, an Anglican church in Westminster, close to the Houses of Parliament and Westminster Abbey. It has long been closely associated with recovering the Catholic heritage of the Church of England. Frank Weston, Bishop of Zanzibar and one of the leaders of that movement, served here from 1896 to 1898. The church was designed by George Gilbert Scott, a prolific Gothic Revival architect, known mainly for churches and cathedrals, who designed or altered over 800 buildings.
